title: Session identifier value in a Set-Cookie header with attributes
summary: A synthetic Set-Cookie response header that sets a session-identifier cookie with Path, Secure, HttpOnly and Max-Age attributes.
rationale: The attributes describe scope and handling, not the credential: the Path, Secure, HttpOnly and lifetime values are not part of the secret, and including them is over-coverage that destroys information readers need. Only the nonce value is the credential span.

expectation.rationale: Flag the cookie-value only, up to the semicolon that starts the attributes. RFC 6265 separates cookie-pair from the attribute-value pairs and describes the session identifier nonce as the replayable item.

sources.supports: servers commonly store a nonce (or "session identifier") in a cookie

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. Authored from the cited standards read on 2026-10-03, before any scanner was consulted. All values are synthetic and were not tested against any service. Header coalescing, parser and action policy, decoded-token mapping and product masking stay with the downstream repositories.
